about: The first-visit intro: five cards, shown once on the home page; replayed from the "Replay intro screens" link at the top of /about, and opened by "What is this?" on deep-linked pages. Each card has a title, one sentence, an image reference and a status: 'live' (it points at something that exists now) or 'coming'. Card 1 must keep the independence and no-token line (npm run check:intro). Images are references: 'published:<id>' is a seeded image in content/snowmoon/illustrations/published.json; Design's cards will replace them.
model_drafted_note: Drafted by the coding agent (Claude, a closed model) on Oct 6, 2026, revised the same day on the owner's direction: the intro is about building on the novel under its license, and the reader connects the text to what is built on it. Shown labelled as model-drafted until the owner edits it; set model_drafted to false, with edited_by_fid and edited_on, when they do.

cards.title: Built on Snowmoon
cards.sentence: Vitalik Buterin released his novel Snowmoon under GPL-3.0, which lets anyone build on it; this is an independent edition, not affiliated with the author, and there is no token.

cards.title: Built in the open
cards.sentence: His reading of that license asks one thing of anyone who builds on the book, that they publish how they made it, so every prompt, script and recipe here is public.

cards.title: Read, listen, and follow the threads
cards.sentence: Read or listen to every chapter, with images, quote cards and adaptations linked to the passages they grew from.

cards.title: Adaptations
cards.sentence: Briefs for retelling scenes from the book, every detail traced to the passage it comes from, as the start of comics, audio dramas and films.

cards.title: Build your own
cards.sentence: Soon you will be able to make images, lines and audiovisual expansions of your own here, published under GPL-3.0 with your name.
